jobs.description:
Role Based in West Chicago

Role Essentials

  • Location: West Chicago, IL

  • This West Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.

  • Benefits: Employee discounts and perks (where applicable).
  • Excellent work-life balance in West Chicago.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible West Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.title: Chicago Full-time Overnight Warehouse Associate | Hiring
jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: Chicago

Job Title: Overnight Warehouse Associate (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: Amazon Based in: Chicago, IL (our growing Chicago office)

Compensation: $21-$25/Hour (approx. $48.4k/Year) Benefits: This role offers competitive pay. Set your own schedule.

Day-to-Day

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.

jobs.title: East Chicago Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate with $20-$23/hr
jobs.description:
Role Based in East Chicago

Key Information

  • Employer: Amazon (Hiring in East Chicago)
  • Worksite: East Chicago, IN
  • Position: Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate (Based in East Chicago)
  • This East Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in East Chicago, IN is growing.
  • Benefit from working in East Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Salary and Benefits

  • Pay: $20-$23/Hour (approx. $26.3k/Year)
  • Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included.
  • Stable workload with modern tooling and processes.

What You'll Do

  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Logistics space in East Chicago.

Mastering the Overnight Middle Mile

If the fulfillment center is the brain of the operation, the sortation center is the central nervous system. Welcome to the critical "middle mile" of the Amazon delivery network. As a Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate, your primary objective is to group and route thousands of packages during the graveyard hours so they reach the correct local delivery hubs right at dawn. For those seeking highly active, fast-paced night shift warehouse jobs that offer intense teamwork and rapid physical movement, this is the ultimate environment.

The Overnight Sortation Experience

Work in a sort center is fundamentally different from a traditional fulfillment role. You are not picking individual items; you are dealing with sealed, completed packages that are moving rapidly down vast networks of conveyor belts. The atmosphere at night is charged, highly focused, and incredibly team-oriented. When the conveyor belts get heavily loaded during the midnight "rush," you will rely on your night-owl teammates to clear the lines and keep the supply chain moving seamlessly.

  1. Rapid Package Routing: You will read complex digital routing labels as packages fly down the line, pulling them off the belt and sorting them into specific geographical chutes or designated postal carts.
  2. Pallet Architecture: You will become a master of spatial reasoning. Sorting requires building perfectly stable, tightly packed pallets of boxes (often referred to as "playing Tetris" by our veteran associates), which are then heavily shrink-wrapped to prevent transit damage.
  3. Fluid Loading Operations: Utilizing manual pallet jacks, you will safely transport these massive, wrapped pallets directly into the bellies of outbound 18-wheeler semi-trailers, staging them for the early morning over-the-road drivers.

"The night sort center moves incredibly fast, but the overnight shift premium is what keeps me here. Working the graveyard shift allows me to manage my college classes during the day while still getting access to Amazon's incredible 401(k) matching and tuition assistance. The night crew is like a family." - A current Night Sortation Associate.

Flexibility and Night Shift Rewards

We understand that modern life requires flexible schedules. Sortation roles offer some of the most adaptable late-night shifts in the logistics careers landscape, including midnight to morning or late evening options. Associates unlock exceptional health, dental, and vision benefits, along with highly competitive shift differentials that significantly boost your base pay when working non-traditional hours. You will need a strong commitment to workplace safety, the ability to lift up to 49 pounds, and a High School diploma or equivalent to join the night team.

jobs.description:
About the position

Moody Bible Institute is seeking a Public Safety Officer to help create a secure and welcoming environment for our students, employees, residents, and guests on our Chicago campus. As part of our Public Safety team, you will play a vital role in protecting our community while supporting Moody's mission of equipping people with the truth of God's Word. The Public Safety Officer is responsible for maintaining the safety and security of Moody Bible Institute's Chicago campus through proactive patrols, emergency response, incident management, and community engagement. This role requires sound judgment, professionalism, and a servant-hearted approach to serving others.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct foot and vehicle patrols to deter and identify security concerns.
  • Serve as a primary responder to campus incidents, alarms, emergency calls, and 911 notifications.
  • Assess, manage, and secure incident scenes while coordinating with emergency responders and city officials.
  • Prepare accurate, timely, and detailed incident reports and related documentation.
  • Monitor and oversee part-time staff and dispatch operations during assigned shifts.
  • Enforce campus policies, including parking regulations and access control procedures.
  • Provide security coverage for campus events and activities.
  • Assist students, employees, and visitors by providing information, guidance, and support.
  • Issue trespass notices when necessary and respond to unauthorized access concerns.
  • Provide security escorts, cash transport support, and executive protection services as assigned.
  • Complete additional departmental duties and special assignments as directed.

Requirements

  • Associate degree or two years of related security, public safety, law enforcement, military, or customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in emergency situations.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

Nice-to-haves

  • Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice or a related field.
  • Illinois PERC Card.
  • Illinois FOID Card.
  • Experience responding to fire, medical, or security incidents.
  • Previous security, law enforcement, campus safety, or military experience.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees.
